title: Enter into Italy
intro: Leave Kamnik early and drive to Kobarid for an optional 45–60-minute photography stop at Napoleon Bridge and the emerald Soča River. Continue to Venice, park once at Autorimessa Comunale in Piazzale Roma, and walk to Rialto Bridge, St. Mark's Square, Doge's Palace and the Bridge of Sighs, with a quick meal if desired. No boat rides or paid sightseeing. Drive to Brescia in the late afternoon. If weather or road conditions make the Soča detour impractical, drive directly from Kamnik to Venice.

stops.name: Kamnik
stops.description: Drive from Slovenia into Italy toward Venice.

stops.name: Soča Valley — Napoleon Bridge, Kobarid
stops.description: Weather-dependent scenic stop: enjoy views of the emerald Soča River and photograph Napoleon Bridge. Allow about 45–60 minutes; skip this detour if conditions or timing are unfavorable.

stops.name: Autorimessa Comunale — Piazzale Roma
stops.description: Park the SUV here once. This is the starting and ending point for the walking visit.

stops.name: Rialto Bridge & Grand Canal
stops.description: Enjoy the Grand Canal view and take photos from the bridge.

stops.name: St. Mark's Square
stops.description: See the basilica and bell tower from outside.

stops.name: Doge's Palace
stops.description: Admire the Venetian Gothic exterior without an admission ticket.

stops.name: Bridge of Sighs
stops.description: Take a quick photo of the famous bridge from the public viewing bridge.

stops.name: Autorimessa Comunale — Piazzale Roma
stops.description: Walk back through the smaller canals, grabbing something quick to eat if desired.

stops.name: Brescia
stops.description: Continue west to your Brescia lodging.
